I've been to that place and bought fish. But the last time, I bought an aquatic plant that was just two cuttings, and they charged me almost $17 for it. I also bought four fish, and two of them died. I called and told them, and they said there was nothing they could do, that it could have been the other fish. It was awful, and it had only been 36 hours since then, and they didn't even offer to help me or give me a discount. They just don't care about earning customers. They're only interested in making a sale and don't offer a guarantee like other places that give up to 3 or even 7 days. It's unbelievable how people just use you to make a purchase and nothing more. I won't be buying from them again, and besides, the aquatic plants are ridiculously expensive. My advice: go to Pemproke Pines. I went there and I'll keep buying there. The quality is better, the care is better, and they give you a 3-day guarantee and a 50% refund if something happens. Plus, the plants are thicker and cheaper. It's a spectacular place with excellent service. Thank you Pemproke Pines for the tremendous service, the beautiful fish, and your guarantee.

I had such a great experience at Neptunes Aquarium! From the moment I walked in, the staff were welcoming, knowledgeable, and eager to help. I was looking for supplies for my new puppy, and they took the time to walk me through different food options, toys, and even gave me tips on training and grooming.

What really stood out was how patient and kind they were—not just to me, but to every customer that came in. You can tell they genuinely care about animals and the people who love them. They even offered to special-order a product that wasn’t in stock.
Highly recommend this shop for anyone who wants personalized service and a team that truly goes above and beyond. I’ll definitely be coming back!
